text.p: Swiss travel and tour group Kuoni Reisen AG said net profit after the first nine months of the year was markedly higher than last year, confirming its mid-year forecast that profit for the full year would significantly exceed 60 million Swiss francs.

Kuoni did not publish a profit figure for the first nine months, but said sales in that period had risen almost 20 percent and for the full year they should reach around 3.4 billion francs, up from 1995's 2.9 billion.
Kuoni reported a 1995 net profit of 45.2 million francs.
The satisfactory results are based on further profit improvements in the strategic business units Switzerland, International and Incoming, Kuoni said in a statement.
SGE England was developing according to targets and would report results similar to the 1995 level, it added.
